title: Multi-level consumers release before their provider and observe the injected binding during cleanup.

divergences.reason: The set is identical - every consumer releases before its provider, each exactly once - but the order inside one teardown pass differs. The reference unloads each fiber's disposables concurrently (Promise.all over the disposables list), so sibling order is not a committed property; Go runs one serial reconciliation driver, so independent cleanups execute in a deterministic reverse-registration order. Consumers still always precede the provider they depend on, which is the ordering the acceptance criteria require; only the order between independent siblings is observable here.
